text: The paper reports that modulating agreement intensity improves performance by about 15% for Multi-Persona and about 5% for Society of Mind on the USMLE subset, while ChatEval is hardly affected, suggesting agreement is not equally modulable in every system. The authors then apply 90% agreement intensity prompts to Multi-Persona on the full MedQA dataset.
title: Agreement modulation gives about 15% gain for Multi-Persona and 5% for SoM
